context: Morning office. Emma is organizing research files for the debate. She's nervous but eager to impress.

nodes.text: Oh! G-Good morning, Mr. John! I was just organizing your research files. Everything is ready for the debate prep.

moodVariations.Stressed: M-Morning, Mr. John. Files are... almost ready. Sorry if I'm in the way.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Hi Mr. John! I got all your research organized. Hope it helps with the debate!
moodVariations.Neutral: Good morning, Mr. John. I was just organizing your research files. Everything is ready for the debate prep.

publicOptions.text: Good morning, Emma. Thank you for getting this done so quickly.
You remind me of a young intern Margaret once mentored. She had your same dedication.
Just make sure the files are in order. I don't have time for mistakes.
You're always working so hard, Emma. Take a break sometimes.
What did you find in your research? Any interesting angles on the women's issues topic?

privateThoughts.text: She's so young and nervous. That innocent act... Maybe I should see how far I can push.
Young interns are loyal if you treat them well. Worth investing in.
Her enthusiasm is... refreshing. Makes me feel younger. More alive.
Flatter her a bit and she'll work twice as hard. Easy investment.
Just give me the files, Emma. I have a debate to prepare for.

nodes.text: Alright, Emma. Thank you for the research. This is excellent work. I'll see you at the debate prep meeting.

moodVariations.Stressed: Thanks for the research. See you at the meeting.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Thanks, Emma! This is great! See you at the debate prep!
moodVariations.Neutral: Thank you for the research, Emma. I'll see you at the debate prep meeting.

publicOptions.text: Thanks, Emma. I'll see you there.
